# middmonitor_host (Resource)

A monitored host (inventory + agent target). `name` is immutable after creation (API).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "middmonitor_host" "web1" {
  name         = "web-prod-01"
  hostname     = "10.0.1.5"
  service      = "api"
  display_name = "API production"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `hostname` (String) Resolvable address or IP used for checks (maps to API field `host`). Changing this recreates the host (API only allows editing the display name).
- `name` (String) Technical host name (unique per org). **Cannot be changed** after create.

### Optional

- `display_name` (String) Human-readable label in the UI.
- `service` (String) Logical application / stack name (defaults to `name` if omitted).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC3339).
- `id` (Number) Host ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Import by numeric ID.
terraform import middmonitor_host.example 42
```
